mapper.select: SELECT id,title,created_at,updated_at FROM chat_session WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT s.id,s.title,s.created_at,s.updated_at FROM chat_session s WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM chat_message m WHERE m.session_id=s.id) ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE session_id=#{id} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE session_id=#{id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET title=CASE WHEN title='新对话' THEN #{title} ELSE title END,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{id}
